entities.summary: Patricia Wiltshire is a forensic ecologist, botanist and palynologist. She has been consulted by police forces and industry in almost 300 investigations in several countries and has been instrumental in solving several high-profile crimes, including the killings of Sarah Payne and Milly Dowler, the cold case of Christopher Laverack, the Soham murders, and the Ipswich serial murders.
